title: Echoes in the Abyss
description: A woman in profile exhales swirling, luminous smoke that transforms into flowing soundwave patterns across a dark void. Vertical audio waveforms, floating particles, and faint light reflections appear above against a deep black background.
prompt: A woman in profile with closed eyes exhaling swirling translucent smoke from her mouth that morphs into elegant flowing soundwave patterns and audio waveforms across a pitch black void. Vertical glitch-like audio visualizations and floating luminous particles fill the dark space, dramatic side lighting, surreal atmosphere, moody and mysterious, painted in dark tones with subtle purple and white highlights.
